subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a permanent registry-backed Labs settings page as the Control UI boundary for experimental feature gates?
rationale: This PR adds a new discoverability and configuration-control surface beyond repairing an established UI contract, and the linked Swarm program remains open for maintainer product calibration.

options.title: Sponsor the Labs boundary
options.body: Approve the Labs page direction, then require the stale-snapshot repair and real Gateway-backed proof before merge.

options.title: Keep experimental gates configuration-only
options.body: Decline this new UI surface and retain the existing documented configuration workflow until a broader Labs product plan is accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Labs boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the Labs page direction, then require the stale-snapshot repair and real Gateway-backed proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR and the linked Swarm proposal identify this person as the active proposer for the Labs direction.
